module: Module 5: Partial Fills, Asymmetric Rejections & Slippage
title: Volume-Weighted Average Price (VWAP) Aggregation
precondition: Block order of 20.0 lots fills across 3 LP price tiers: 5.0 @ 1.0800, 10.0 @ 1.0802, 5.0 @ 1.0804.
expected_result: All child tickets booked at exact identical VWAP price (1.080200); zero price discrimination among investors.
actual_result: VWAP calculated with 6-decimal precision: 1.080200. All child tickets receive identical fair price.
